issue: OWN-1 (owner requirement): every number in the HUD tiles (Stability, Kings, Roll, Cards, Aces, Tokens, including each /max) uses the LED face (--font-led, DSEG7 Classic), as the Roll tile already does (src/lib/components/status/RollCell.svelte: the digits over faint unlit "88" segments). The values must read as one family across the six tiles, align on one baseline, and fit at 360px wide.

OWN-2 (owner requirement): every HUD tile uses the Kings tile's progressive styling. As its value moves into a new tier, the tile background shifts slightly to a fitting colour (the reference is the Kings tile's urgent gradient in src/lib/components/status/KingsCell.svelte, .urgent) and the value's colour changes with it. Each tile needs tiers that fit what its value means to the player: Stability by stabilityTier (steady, caution, danger, critical) in hudTiers.js; Tokens falling is good news; Cards running out is pressure; Aces rising is hope (Salvation unlocking); the Roll tile for a natural 20, a natural 1, and a pending Lucid or Surreal. Subtle, on-palette, legible, eased with the animation tokens, instant under reduced motion, and never louder than the Kings at 3 of 4.

surface: Board step button, card mechanic note, Help rule tip, Settings difficulty help, Aces tooltip
issue: With four Aces on Normal/Hard each Salvation is a Stability check and the game is lost if it takes Stability to 0, but the copy promises the opposite: button 'ROLL FOR STABILITY · SALVATION IS ASSURED', card note 'ACE · SALVATION IS NOW ASSURED' / 'Salvation unlocked · assured' / 'Salvation will be assured', Help and Settings 'automatic after a Stability check'.

Captions queue first-in first-out, one per screen and only on a screen type other than the last caption's, with their text frozen when the trigger fires. In a real Normal game the King caption shows on Salvation, Ace on round 2, Lucid on round 2's check, Surreal on round 2's Salvation, and 'Salvation unlocked' first shows in round 3, after two Salvation screens. Stale text: caption-ace says 'You now need 17+' while the HUD shows Aces 2/4 (14+). caption-lucid and caption-surreal say 'Your next roll uses two dice' on a screen whose roll doesn't: there is no hint on the button and the arrows are dim. Three captions write 'salvation' in lower case, and the King caption opens with a bare '1 of 4.'

surface: Board column: rule caption, eyebrow (card line), screen title, description/result, notice
issue: The column's bottom is pinned to the 40% line and it grows upwards. Each extra line (caption, eyebrow, two-line title, two- or three-line result) lifts the title, so the eye's anchor moves on almost every press. This is the owner's named defect.

'Surreal: 2 dice, keep low' is #d946ef on the purple button (#8223bf): 2.06:1, unreadable at the moment the rule matters. Because the hint is a second line inside the button, the button grows 17-36px upwards (its top moves, its bottom stays).

--hud-bottom is published once on mount and refreshed only on a size change or a window resize, so it holds 980/1040px while the HUD ends at ~130px. .static-roll is placed below the viewport, and a reduced-motion player never sees the roll, only 'Rolling…'.

At 1440px the column is 960px wide, yet 'STABILITY CHECK' sets in two lines and 'FINAL STABILITY CHECK' in three (614×185px). At 56px, lixdu needs about 1.18em per character. The three-line title is the tallest thing on the board and pushes the result down.

surface: Board description, result line, step button, rule caption
issue: The same fact is said 2-4 times on one screen. salvation-n2-step: 'Roll to remove a token. You need 14+.' and the button 'ROLL TO REMOVE A TOKEN · NEED 14+'. caption-easy-fourth-ace: 'survive … and you escape' in the caption, the description and the button. caption-odd: caption, description and button all say roll to lose Stability. task-result: 'Draw 5 cards' in the result line and the button. round-start: the description restates 'ROLL FOR TASKS'. A natural 1 is explained in the result line, the caption, the next button and the HUD.

The Stability check button says 'ROLL FOR DAMAGE'; the identical roll on the same table says 'ROLL FOR STABILITY' (four-Ace Salvation, Easy final check). 'Damage' appears nowhere else, and a natural 20 heals.

The grammar changes by outcome. A plain check ends with the total ('· 18/20'); a natural 1 or 20 drops the total and adds a 9-word rule ('Surreal: your next roll keeps the lower of two dice'); Salvation adds '· 5 left'. The totals repeat the HUD, and the rule sentence makes the line 2-3 lines tall (44-68px at 360), which lifts the title 24-48px.

surface: Result line and ending cause line for the token win

On the ending, the Kings, Stability and fourth-Ace endings carry a cause line, but the token win has none (endingSummary.js returns ''), even though the timeline already says 'The last token was removed.'

Long labels wrap. On phones the Salvation and final-check labels take two lines, so the button is 62px tall instead of 44px. On landscape the label area is 214px at 18px: even 'ROLL FOR INSTABILITY' wraps, and 'ROLL FOR STABILITY / · SALVATION / IS ASSURED' is three lines with one starting on '·'.

The key-cap is an inline item after the label and the two are centred together, so the label sits about 30px left of the button's centre. The key-cap's x changes with every label (741→897px on desktop), and the long Salvation label nearly touches the left chamfer.

surface: HUD Roll tile during a roll

surface: Game load and the intro; the reduced-motion static roll
issue:
The loadGame block in GameScreen.svelte has transition:fade (lines 789-796), so it stays in normal flow during its 200ms out-transition, and .game-screen mounts below it, one viewport down.

surface: HUD row: all six value tiles (OWN-1)
issue:
OWN-1 is not met: Stability, Kings, Cards, Aces, Tokens and every /max are Share Tech Mono. Only Roll is DSEG7, and it is larger than the other values (22/26/20px against 20/24/18px), so the lit digits do not share a box.

A straight swap to LED digits has five fit problems:
- Fit is tight at 360.
- DSEG7 has no slash glyph.
- A leading '1' leaves a gap.
- Values jitter sideways as their digit count changes.
- The Roll tile's baseline is off from the others.

OWN-2 is not met: only Kings has a tier background (.urgent). Two layout problems block a clean result.
- The row's side padding sits on .status-hud, so the first and last cells start inside the frame. A Stability or Tokens tint would leave an untinted strip against the frame.
- Tiers must not reflow. Columns are minmax(min-content, fr), so any tier change in weight, size, padding or border moves every cell.
The button grows from 44px to as much as 89px when its label wraps or carries the Lucid/Surreal hint. Its bottom stays put, so its top edge and the label jump upwards between steps.
